events.title: Ringling Bros. and Barnum & Bailey Circus
events.meetingPlace: Village of New Haven Municipal Offices
events.notes: Village of New Haven Parks & Recreation trip. Bus leaves the municipal offices at 1:30 PM and is expected back in the village around 6:30 PM. Registration is currently being accepted at the municipal offices, with payment due when registering. The flyer does not state a separate registration deadline.

tasks.title: Register and pay for the circus trip
tasks.details: Pay $30 per person at registration at the Village of New Haven Municipal Offices. No separate registration deadline is listed.

tasks.title: Be at the municipal offices for the 1:30 PM departure
tasks.details: Departure location: 57775 Main Street, New Haven, MI 48048. The bus is expected back around 6:30 PM.
